topics.title: Faith & trust
topics.description: Trust God when the way ahead is uncertain. Read Bible devotions about courage, doubt, and holding to His promises.

topics.title: Prayer
topics.description: Bring your fears, questions, and gratitude to God. These devotions explore honest prayer and dependence on Him.

topics.title: Hope & encouragement
topics.description: Find encouragement in accounts of people who met God in loss, loneliness, danger, and discouragement.

topics.title: Forgiveness & grace
topics.description: Reflect on the mercy of Jesus, the invitation to repent, and the grace that welcomes us back to God.

topics.title: Wisdom & discernment
topics.description: Learn from Scripture about listening well, testing what we hear, and making choices with humility.

topics.title: Humility & obedience
topics.description: Consider what it means to receive God’s Word, surrender pride, and follow Him in everyday decisions.

topics.title: Love & service
topics.description: Explore practical compassion, generosity, peacemaking, and faith expressed through care for other people.

topics.title: Waiting on God
topics.description: Read about patient faith when answers take time, circumstances remain difficult, or the next step is unclear.

devotions.title: Remember the Creator
devotions.subject: Creation and the first Sabbath
devotions.keyVerse: “And God blessed the seventh day and declared it holy, because it was the day when he rested from all his work of creation.”
devotions.summary: Creation reveals whose world this is and whose we are. Reflect on human dignity, stewardship, and the seventh-day Sabbath as God’s gift.

videos.title: He Blessed One Day and Called It Holy.

devotions.title: The Serpent, the Fruit and the First Hiding
devotions.subject: Temptation, shame, and the God who comes looking for us
devotions.keyVerse: “Then the LORD God called to the man, ‘Where are you?’”
devotions.summary: Genesis 3 traces temptation, shame, hiding, and blame—then reveals the God who comes looking for us and speaks hope before the sentence is finished.

videos.title: A Question Came Before the Fruit.

devotions.title: Enoch: Walking With God
devotions.subject: Enoch’s life of faith and close fellowship with God
devotions.keyVerse: “Enoch lived 365 years, walking in close fellowship with God. Then one day he disappeared, because God took him.”
devotions.summary: Enoch’s brief biography is defined by close fellowship with God. Reflect on faith, ordinary daily obedience, courageous witness, and hope in Christ’s return.

videos.title: Four Verses. Said Twice.

devotions.keyVerse: “Come, let’s build a great city for ourselves with a tower that reaches into the sky.”
devotions.summary: Reflect on the tower of Babel in Genesis 11 and the difference between building a name for ourselves and trusting God.

devotions.summary: Esau’s birthright in Genesis 25 invites us to consider how today’s desires shape our choices and what we value most.

devotions.title: Faith That Will Not Bow
devotions.subject: Three men and the blazing furnace
devotions.keyVerse: “If we are thrown into the blazing furnace, the God whom we serve is able to save us. He will rescue us from your power, Your Majesty. But even if he doesn’t, we want to make it clear to you, Your Majesty, that we will never serve your gods or worship the gold statue you have set up.”
devotions.summary: The three men in Daniel 3 choose faithfulness in the furnace. Reflect on trusting God even when the outcome is uncertain.

videos.title: They Chose The Furnace

devotions.title: Daniel Prayed Anyway

devotions.keyVerse: “But when Daniel learned that the law had been signed, he went home and knelt down as usual in his upstairs room, with its windows open toward Jerusalem. He prayed three times a day, just as he had always done, giving thanks to his God.”
devotions.summary: Daniel 6 reveals a life rooted in daily prayer. Reflect on faithful habits, courage, and trusting God under pressure.

videos.title: His Only “Crime” Was Prayer

devotions.title: Clothed by Grace: Joshua Before the Angel
devotions.subject: Joshua the high priest, the accuser, and God’s gift of clean garments
devotions.keyVerse: “See, I have taken away your sins, and now I am giving you these fine new clothes.”
devotions.summary: Joshua stood accused in filthy garments, but God took away his sins and clothed him anew. Reflect on forgiveness, Christ’s righteousness, and faithful service.

videos.title: He Stood Accused. God Changed His Clothes.

devotions.prayer: Father, thank You that the accuser does not have the last word over Your children. Give me honest repentance and keep me from despair. Thank You, Lord Jesus, for taking away what I could never wash out and for clothing me in Your righteousness. Now give me grace to walk in Your ways and serve You faithfully today. Amen.

devotions.title: When Did We See You, Lord?
devotions.subject: Meeting Christ in the hungry, the stranger, the sick, and the forgotten
devotions.keyVerse: “And the King will say, ‘I tell you the truth, when you did it to one of the least of these my brothers and sisters, you were doing it to me!’”
devotions.summary: Jesus calls us to see Him in the people we might overlook. Reflect on Matthew 25, practical compassion, and the love His grace produces.

videos.title: They Served Jesus Without Knowing It

devotions.prayer: Lord Jesus, thank You for loving me before I had anything to give. Forgive me for the needs I have learned not to see. Open my eyes to the people You have placed within my reach, give me compassion and wisdom, and let Your love become visible in the way I treat them today. Amen.
